props.gloss_en: one does not strain mustard in its strainer
and one does not sweeten it with a coal

Rav Yosef: there [the egg] it does not look like selecting
Rav Yosef: here [the mustard] it looks like selecting
the baraita: one sweetens it with a coal
here [where permitted] -- with a metal coal
there [where forbidden] -- with a wood coal
Rav Yosef: there [meat on coals] it is not possible [otherwise]
Rav Yosef: here [sweetening mustard with a coal] it is possible [otherwise]
Abaye: what of making cheese? Rav Yosef: it is forbidden

Rav Yosef: there [kneading] it is not possible
Rav Yosef: here [making cheese] it is possible
the Nehardeans: one-day cheese is excellent
